items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Reese Cobet' and asks if the interviewee heard of him, but the interviewee does not respond to this specific question in the provided context, nor does the interviewee mention Cobet.

ctx.x: There was a Cobet tour, a Reese Cobet. I don't know if he's in this city, he left four years ago too. Fat fella, saxophone player too. Cobet.
Yeah. Well, another trumpet I was going to ask you about, did you hear of Bunk Johnson ever when you were young?
